featured_reviews.name: Shrikant Soman
featured_reviews.review_text:
Zen Garden Kandarpada: Mumbai's Rustic Sanctuary on the Edge
Zen Garden Kandarpada is far more than just a park; it is a stunning testament to citizen initiative, visionary design, and Mumbai's unexpected natural beauty. Located at the extreme north end of the city's boundary, this landscape offers a rustic and tranquil retreat unlike any other green space in the metropolis.
From Barren Rock to Breathtaking Zen
The garden's origin story is as compelling as its design. What was once a challenging, barren, and rocky area adjacent to the vast Kandarpada mangroves was transformed through a dedicated public campaign initiated by local citizens. Spearheaded by Shri Vinod Ghosalkar and the DSF club, this area was thoughtfully converted into a beautiful Zen landscape.
The genius of the design lies in the way it embraces the existing topography. The local, challenging rocky terrain was used advantageously to create an authentic, rustic Zen atmosphere. Dominating the landscape are massive rock formations—some reaching a staggering 17 to 18 feet in height and width—which give the garden a dramatic, unique character that truly sets it apart in Mumbai. It is a genuine piece of environmental art.
A Unique Experience and Breathtaking Views
Now well-maintained by the BMC, the garden provides a pristine and peaceful environment for a daily stroll or quiet contemplation. The paths wind naturally around the huge boulders, leading visitors deeper into the sanctuary.
A key highlight is the Machan (watchtower). From this vantage point, visitors are treated to a truly breathtaking, uninterrupted view of the massive land of mangroves stretching out towards the west. For photographers and nature lovers, this spot is unparalleled, offering spectacularly beautiful shots of the sunset painting the western horizon over the vast mangrove landscape.
A Must-Visit for Tranquility
Zen Garden Kandarpada successfully merges the rugged, wild nature of Mumbai’s borderlands with the calming aesthetic of a Zen landscape. It stands as a prime example of successful ecological and community transformation, offering locals and visitors a unique space for peace, reflection, and spectacular nature viewing. This is, without a doubt, a must-visit spot on Mumbai's map.

featured_reviews.name: Nikhil Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mandapeshwar Caves in Borivali is a wonderful hidden gem that offers a peaceful break from the city’s hustle. These ancient rock-cut caves, dating back to the 8th century, feature beautiful stone carvings and serve as a serene shrine dedicated to Lord Shiva.
Nestled near Mount Poinsur, the site feels calm and spiritual, making it perfect for devotees, history lovers, or anyone seeking a quiet escape in nature. The intricate sculptures from over 1,200 years ago and timeless beauty create a refreshing atmosphere that leaves you feeling relaxed and inspired. A truly positive and soul soothing visit. Best visited in mornings in summers.

featured_reviews.name: Binay Dangol
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mandapeshwar Caves, located in Borivali, Mumbai, are a significant historical site. These caves, approximately 1.8 km from the Borivali railway station, date back to the 1st century CE. They are renowned for their intricate carvings, including depictions of Lord Vishnu and other deities, highlighting their religious and cultural importance. The site showcases the architectural brilliance of ancient rock-cut temples and offers a glimpse into early Indian religious art and history. You can explore these caves to gain insights into the religious practices and artistry prevalent during that era.

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a historical place having a great significance from the Peshwas regimes. It is believed that there was a secret passage from here to Vasai fort in the reign of Chimajiappa. The pasage was blocked due to untoward incidents happening in them. The scriptures need a renovation to preserve the ruins. In our schools we used to collect oil for lighting lamps here on Tripurari Purnima. Every year the festival was celebrated here and place enlightened with oil lamps was very picturesque. There is Shiva Temple at the center where daily Pooja's are offered by devotees. The garden along the periphery is used as recreational purpose by local who visit the temple and enjoy the recreational space here. The entry to the upper super structure is restricted due to the deterioration of the structure. The structure needs to be revived to it's original Glory.

featured_reviews.review_text: This place is indeed beautiful! It definitely exceeded my expectations. It's the perfect place to sit and relax for hours. The greenery is so peaceful. We visited this place on a weekend by taking the 462 AC bus from Borivali station the East side exit. The climb from here is through a small village here. Vaghdevi Waterfall was a great trek and a good place to enjoy waterfalls during monsoons. You could visit this place with your friends. There's also another exit towards Mira Road side, if you take the longer walking route. One negative aspect is that some people come here and indulge in consuming alcohol and throw the bottles there on the path which is dangerous for people and with the other people throwing plastic waste here it's just destroying the flora and fauna. It's a highly recommended place if you're looking for an adventurous weekend with your friends. This place is a gem in monsoons, enjoying the waterfall and nature in the rains with amazing scenic views. The view from the top is totally worth the climb.

featured_reviews.name: Remon
featured_reviews.review_text:
Vaghdevi waterfalls is a medium level trekking spot great for people who are looking for a short adventure in all the hustle and bustle.

Info:
It takes approximately 3 hrs to go to the top and come back assuming you are spending 10-20 mins at the top.

Best time to visit:
-During mild rains or when it is cold during morning time.
-8-9am is the sweet spot to start you're trekk

Note:
-There are tricky spots to get through but nothing too difficult. Consider this when you are taking a huge group as everyone will not be able to make it through.
-The trekk will definitely be exhausting for first timers.
-Try to reach at top with only one break as muscles will tighten if you take more breaks and it will be tough to complete then.
-Urge you guys not to leave trekk half way as reaching at the top is worth it.
-Take only sips of water and don't drink a lot while climbing.

Things to carry:
-Some eatables(Protein bars chips etc)
- 2 bottles of water per person.

Attire:
-Shoes (Compulsorily)
-Tracks or shorts
-T shirt

PLEASE DONT THROW WASTE AROUND. KEEP IT IN YOU'RE BAG AND THROUGH IT LATER.

featured_reviews.review_text:

The vibe, the energy, and the whole experience were just amazing. It felt refreshing, exciting, and something I’d definitely recommend to everyone at least once.

featured_reviews.name: Harshvi Trivedi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I've been closely associated with Mumbai Travel Club and have seen firsthand how much effort goes into organizing each event. The midnight cycling rides are among the most popular activities, with well-planned routes, cycle rental support, and regular weekend batches.

Apart from cycling events, Mumbai Travel Club also organizes photo walks and outdoor activities around Mumbai. The focus is on creating enjoyable experiences, maintaining safety, and helping people explore the city in a different way. They also have Tours starting from Mumbai with end to end assistance.

What I appreciate most is the attention given to participants, whether they are experienced cyclists or joining for the first time. The team is responsive, the events are organized, and the overall experience is designed to be simple and enjoyable.

featured_reviews.name: Abhishek Chhatraband
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing experience cycling at midnight in Mumbai with Mumbai Travel Club! 🚴‍♂️🌙
The ride was well organized, safe, and full of positive energy. Cycling through the quiet streets of Mumbai at night was a completely different and refreshing experience.

The team was very supportive and ensured everyone was comfortable throughout the ride. It was a great way to meet new people and explore the city in a unique way.

Highly recommended for anyone who loves cycling and adventure! Looking forward to joining more rides with Mumbai Travel Club. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

featured_reviews.review_text:

name: South Mumbai Heritage Walk by MDT
description:
The Mumbai Heritage Walk is a great way to experience the city’s vibrant culture and rich history.
Mumbai Heritage Walk is probably known as the ‘dream city’ and rightly so the city is indeed like a beautiful, magnificent dream. Old Mumbai is the part of Mumbai that represents its heritage and history. Reflecting on the time of Colonial era, the area is studded with numerous tourist attractions. From Chhatrapati Shivaji terminus to the ‘White town’ to the University library to the magnificent Marine drive, the city has so many spectacular attractions that one can never miss. Explore all these places of Old Mumbai and many more with this heritage walk tour.

Walking tours expose many residents and visitors to the structures.

featured_reviews.name: Sanket Mahajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Late post : We did our Meghalaya trip in Jan 2026 with Luxor Trails, and honestly, it turned out to be a really good experience overall.
The biggest plus was the way the itinerary was planned. It wasn’t just the usual Shillong–Cherrapunji trip—they included places like Mawlynnong, Dawki, Kupli, Krem Chympe, and Nongjrong, which made the whole journey feel a lot more unique. The bamboo trek, cave exploration, and boating were some of the highlights for me.
The stays were also nicely picked:
Sha Ri Loum (Shillong) was a comfortable start
Abode of Clouds (Cherrapunji) had great views
Na I Mai home stay (Mawlynnong) felt very local and peaceful and one of the best.
Kupli Orchid Resort was good parts of the trip
Hotel Sweet Chilly was simple but did the job
Lara’s Homestay (Nongjrong) was a perfect, calm ending to the trip
Nothing felt random—everything was aligned with the route, which helped a lot because travel in Meghalaya can get tiring.
Execution-wise, things were smooth. Pickups, transfers, and overall coordination were handled well, so we didn’t have to stress about logistics and could just enjoy the trip.
If I had to point out something, I’d say a bit more buffer time on some days would help, because the roads and travel time in Meghalaya can be unpredictable.
Overall, I’d definitely recommend Luxor Trails if you want a well-planned trip with a mix of popular and offbeat places without having to worry too much about arrangements.

​Rating: ⭐☆☆☆☆
​If you are thinking about using Swayourway, do yourself a huge favor and close the tab right now. This company is a masterclass in how to alienate customers.

​Zero Accountability (Ghosted!): When the platform inevitably failed, I reached out for urgent technical support. Days went by without a single reply. They completely ghosted me after taking my payment. There is absolutely no post-purchase support.
​Impossible Refund Policy: When I realized the service was completely unusable, I requested a refund under their supposed "satisfaction guarantee." Of course, they pulled out obscure, hidden clauses from their terms and conditions to deny it.
